Bettina, I saved the draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup". It is in drafts and has not been sent. I replied in the #coastal-team thread to say so.

I added your two points: the Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments, and the Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows. The rest is Sofia's bullets: the 16 Feb rename, the saved report that still reads 'Covey — Late Arrivals', and the ask to use full names instead of bare "PHL". I haven't seen Moss's digest myself, so that point rests on Sofia's message. The draft is signed from you.
